summary: Added GET /graph/delta?since=<ISO-8601> to the daemon (commit fa5ac23, main) — the read-only change sensor for the nightly-QA loop. Response: { since, now, counts, status_changes[ {key,label,status,lastChanged} incl. reached done/tested/canceled ], tasks_created[ {key,label,status,firstSeen} ], notes_added[ {key,title,summary,created_at} ], merges[ {key,winner,at} ] }. 400 on missing/unparseable since; derived purely from existing overlay timestamps (no new persisted state, no mutation). Caveat: merges = verdict knowledge items that CARRY a timestamp only — verdicts are free-form and most carry none, so the merges bucket is best-effort (omitted, never invented). Logic in lib/delta.js (pure); MCP tool graph_delta added to the shared catalog (lib/mcp-core.js — mcp-graph.js serves it automatically on both transports). Tests: new test/graph-delta.test.js 28/28 pass; full unit suite 28 files all green (453 assertions); smoke.sh 74 pass / 11 fail but those 11 are PRE-EXISTING on clean HEAD (stale singleton-loop expectations vs the keyed loop registry), verified via a HEAD worktree run. Endpoint also verified live on an isolated :8798 daemon (400/400/200 shape). NOTE: daemon restart required to activate — the live :8787 daemon still runs old code.
